correctness.rationale: Parseval gives precisely the alias of coefficients 0 and 8 of F², equivalently the merge of autocorrelations ±4. The reflected RMS step improves each nonnegative correlation, strictly improving some nonzero lag for unequal reflected magnitudes. The independent envelope calculation optimizes first in t=u² and then factors the derivative of the resulting rational function in v into a negative positive factor times v⁴+4v³−7v−2; the unique positive root is the global maximum, including the boundary checks. Positive magnitudes force affine phases by equality in the lag-one triangle inequality; the merged lag-four term forces phase increment in (π/4)Z, giving exactly eight classes. The exact formula is correct; the printed K approximation is off in the last displayed digit (K=3.527901483813719443…); the quoted floating-point quadrature is diagnostic, not an exact check.
